instruction: I need to standardize the typography across my presentation. Can you change all text boxes to use 'Ubuntu' font instead of the current font?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing all text fonts from Arial to Ubuntu in all 28 slides. Evaluator verifies that all text runs use Ubuntu font. Verified by analyzing source file: 28 slides with Arial font need to be changed.

Metric correctly verifies that only the target font 'Ubuntu' is used throughout the presentation
